repo.description:
### Summary

An attacker with ability to import keys into Transit only at a specific name via an ACL policy containing `name` as a `required_parameters` value can bypass this restriction and import for all key names via a path-traversal vulnerability during import.

This vulnerability is original to HashiCorp Vault. 

### Patches

This is patched in OpenBao v2.7.2. A special v2.6.5 release has been cut but note that v2.6.x series is officially unsupported upstream; please migrate to the v2.7.x series.
repo.summary: OpenBao's Transit allows import of key material at arbitrary paths
